scenes.text: Here is the big picture. The snake lives on a grid, and every move either takes it to a free cell, onto food, or into a wall or its own body. We need to track the head, the body and the food, and check each move before we make it.
So we start.
The snake starts at the top-left cell with length 1.
Now a move. The head goes one cell in the chosen direction, and before anything else we ask whether that cell is still on the grid. Leaving the grid ends the game.
So we move R.
Move R: the head moves to [0,1].
The head moved to an empty cell. The tail moves up by one, which keeps the length the same, and the score does not change.
So we slide.
The head moves, the tail follows. Score 0.
